entries.text: 在咱们食堂，阿若我觉得啊～\n学园套餐是最推荐的！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_03

entries.text: 整体比较柔软，\n不怎么嚼也没问题。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_04

entries.text: 对吧～？嘿嘿嘿，\n你很明白嘛。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_05

entries.text: 嘿嘿嘿，\n你说话好像我妈啊～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_06

entries.text: 以你的实力，\n能在蓝莓联盟争第一了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_08

entries.text: 要是交换留学生能在学园\n成为第一，肯定超～有趣吧？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_09

entries.text: 所以，我希望[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你\n参加蓝莓联盟。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_10

entries.text: 什么事不事的，\n这里是食堂哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_12

entries.text: 我只是想邀请你\n一起吃个饭而已～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_13

entries.text: 有这闲工夫，\n把宝可梦变强一点怎么样？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_brother_03

entries.text: 你就是这样才会输给我。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_brother_04

entries.text: 就算有乌栗你最～喜欢的\n朋友在，也不行吗～？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_15

entries.text: 咦～？你不知道吗？\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她是来交换留学的呀。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_16

entries.text: 我也是在入口那边\n听席蓝校长介绍的……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_02

entries.text: 我还邀请了[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她\n参加蓝莓联盟哦～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_18

entries.text: 其他学校的学生\n参加蓝莓联盟……史无前例。[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_steelbb_01

entries.text: 什么嘛，\n说什么见外的话！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_19

entries.text: 在咱们这儿上课，\n还住在咱们这儿的宿舍！\r\n这还算不上是同一个学园的伙伴吗！？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_20

entries.text: 再说了，咱们学校\n重视学生的自主性。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_21

entries.text: 我当然举双手赞成。\n……紫竽你呢？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_23

entries.text: 我觉得……抱歉，\n从规则上来说应该不行……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_06

entries.text: 只要在学园里\n就算学生，对吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_firebb_03

entries.text: 纳莉我，依照规则，\n表示反对。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_steelbb_02

entries.text: 那好～蓝莓联盟的\n乌栗冠军，\r\n您的意见如何呀？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_25

entries.text: 杜若！\n我觉得这样不好哦！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_fairybb_09

entries.text: 总觉得害你不得不顺势\n参加蓝莓联盟了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_28

entries.text: 凡事要看你怎么去想！\n这或许是你和乌栗加深感情的机会！？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_29

entries.text: 别担心～\n我也会好好照看你的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_30

entries.text: 既然这么定了，\n就得正式报名才行。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_31

entries.text: 嘿嘿嘿，你来啦！\n就是在这里报名。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0110_dragonbb_33
